start_enabled.description: Whether to enable knxd at boot via init script (START_KNXD=YES/NO). Note: systemd users should edit /etc/knxd.conf instead.

bus_remote.description: Remote KNX/IP gateway address (e.g., '192.168.1.50' or 'ipt:192.168.1.2'). Required when bus_type is 'ip', 'ipt', or 'knxip'. Ignored otherwise.

bus_local.description: Custom KNX individual address in 'a.b.c' format (e.g., '1.1.0'). Leave empty to auto-assign (0.0.1).

log_level.description: Logging verbosity: 0 (none) to 6 (trace). 4 = info (recommended for production). Only applied if log_destination != 'syslog'.

log_destination.description: Where to send logs: 'syslog', 'file', or 'stdout'. Only affects '-v' and '-l' flags if not 'syslog'.

monitor_groups.description: Optional list of KNX group addresses to monitor (e.g., '1/2/3' or range '1/2/0-15'). Maps to '-m' flag.
